title: The War of Bloodlines
summary: Inside the Primordial Mindscape, Ha-Jun confronts the manifestation of his ancient lineage—a chaotic war between the original Demon Sovereign's memories and his own human soul.

panels.shot: the primordial mindscape: an endless black ocean beneath red nebulas
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands on an infinite surface of calm black water reflecting millions of crimson stars and swirling galaxies.

panels.shot: floating above the water: thousands of glowing memory crystals
panels.action: Thousands of crystalline shards float in mid-air, each displaying a battle or coronation from five thousand years of demon history.

panels.shot: kuro flying beside ha-jun in radiant purple phoenix aura
panels.action: Kuro glides across the water surface: 'This is the Absolute Root of the Sovereign Bloodline. Every past emperor's will sleeps here.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yahan past ke 99 Sovereigns ka consciousness rehta hai.

panels.shot: a dark silhouette rising from the black water fifty yards ahead
panels.action: From the calm black water rises a figure identical in height and build to Ha-Jun, clad in obsidian dragon armor.

panels.shot: the figure looking up: dark ha-jun with pitch-black sclera and burning red pupils
panels.action: The doppelganger looks up: Ha-Jun's exact handsome face, but with black sclera, burning crimson irises, and two obsidian horns.

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: Welcome to your true self, Ha-Jun Kang.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing the sanguine fang pointing it at the shadow
panels.action: Ha-Jun unsheathes his starlight blade: 'You are the Void Primordial that infected Asmodaius.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum mere andar ka darr aur nafrat ho.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun drawing a mirror blade of black anti-matter
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun unsheathes an identical katana forged of pitch-black void anti-matter: 'I am not just fear. I am your absolute power!'

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: Without me, you are just a weak student who wept on a rooftop!

panels.shot: the two ha-juns sprinting across the black water at mach 15
panels.action: The light and dark versions of Ha-Jun sprint across the black ocean, water splashing in supersonic wake rings.

panels.shot: blades collide: a massive shockwave of starlight and void splits the ocean
panels.action: Katana meets katana; a mile-wide trench opens in the black ocean as red and purple lightning arcs into the nebulas.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun kicking ha-jun chest sending him skipping across water
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun drives an armored boot into Ha-Jun's ribs, sending him skipping across the water surface like a flat stone.

panels.shot: ha-jun planting his boots digging trenches in the water to halt
panels.action: Ha-Jun digs his boots into the surface tension, stopping his skid fifty yards away, breathing hard.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: His strength... It's exactly identical to mine!

panels.shot: kuro diving with burning talons raking across shadow ha-jun shoulder
panels.action: Kuro dives in, raking his solar talons across Shadow Ha-Jun's pauldron, sending black sparks flying.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun backhanding kuro with a dark gravitational pulse
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun backhands Kuro with an anti-gravity pulse, blasting the phoenix fifty yards across the water.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun leaping 100 feet in the air bringing both hands down
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun rockets into the sky, swinging his void blade down in a colossal guillotine stroke.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting chains of ruin to snare shadow ha-jun arms mid-air
panels.action: Ha-Jun summons Chains of Ruin; four heavy black links wrap around the shadow's wrists, freezing him in mid-air.

panels.shot: ha-jun pulling the chains slamming shadow ha-jun into the water
panels.action: Ha-Jun yanks the chains with both arms, slamming his dark reflection face-first into the black water.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun dissolving into black liquid and reforming behind ha-jun
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun liquefies into the black water and reconstitutes directly behind Ha-Jun's back with blade poised.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun whispering in ha-jun ear: 'why do you fight to protect mortals?'
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun whispers into his ear: 'Mortals beat you. They called you an orphan. Why die for them?'

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: Humans hated you. Why not let them burn?

panels.shot: ha-jun elbows backward smashing shadow ha-jun in the jaw
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives a reinforced elbow straight into the shadow's jaw, shattering teeth and knocking him back.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Because my brother loved me. And Min-Jae stood by me.

panels.shot: ha-jun spinning and slashing across shadow ha-jun chestplate
panels.action: Ha-Jun follows with a spinning horizontal cleave, carving a deep wound across the shadow's obsidian armor.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun laughing wiping black blood from his split lip
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun wipes black ichor from his lip, laughing with dark joy: 'Yes! That hatred! That anger! Give it to me!'

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: Every drop of wrath you feel makes me stronger!

panels.shot: ha-jun realizing the paradox: fighting with anger only feeds the shadow
panels.action: Ha-Jun freezes; he sees his own anger flowing like dark mist into the shadow's muscles.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: I can't destroy him with hatred... That's what created him in the first place.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun expanding into a 30-foot demonic titan of anti-matter
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun swells into a colossal thirty-foot demon monarch, wielding a 20-foot broadsword of black flame.

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: I AM THE ACCUMULATED WRATH OF FIVE THOUSAND YEARS!!

panels.shot: ha-jun sheathing the sanguine fang with a quiet click
panels.action: Ha-Jun lowers his arms and slides the blood katana back into its scabbard with a calm, decisive click.

panels.shot: kuro landing beside ha-jun watching with breathless curiosity
panels.action: Kuro tilts his head: 'Ha-Jun... What are you doing?'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: You are putting away your sword?!

panels.shot: ha-jun walking calmly toward the 30-foot shadow titan with open hands
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks calmly across the water toward the towering titan, hands empty, eyes serene and clear.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: You are not my enemy. You are just my pain.

panels.shot: shadow titan swinging the 20-foot broadsword down at ha-jun head
panels.action: The colossal black sword crashes down directly at Ha-Jun's exposed, unarmored head.

panels.shot: ha-jun catching the giant blade with a gentle touch of both palms
panels.action: Ha-Jun doesn't block with force; he catches the edge between gentle, glowing palms, diffusing the kinetic energy.

panels.shot: golden starlight flowing from ha-jun hands into the dark blade
panels.action: Warm golden light flows from Ha-Jun's skin, turning the pitch-black anti-matter blade into clean crystal glass.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: I accept you. You kept me alive when I was weak. But you don't control me anymore.

panels.shot: the shadow titan cracking with blinding golden fractures cliffhanger
panels.action: Spiderweb fractures of pure golden light spread across the 30-foot titan as integration begins!

dialogue.text: THE SHADOW SUBMITS. THE TRUE SOVEREIGN EMERGES.
